summary: News Corp filed an 8-K reporting daily disclosures to the Australian Securities Exchange regarding its ongoing stock repurchase program. The program authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate buybacks of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing includes Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 with ASX transaction details but provides no specific repurchase amounts, prices, or dates. This is a routine periodic update on an existing buyback authorization, reflecting the issuer's ongoing capital return activity. No material new terms are disclosed.
